venue_name: Los Angeles County Superior Court — Small Claims Division

forms.name: Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court
forms.description: The primary small claims filing form. Lists the plaintiff, defendant, claim amount, and basis for the claim.

forms.name: Declaration of Nonmilitary Status (Federal)
forms.description: Required declaration that the defendant is not on active military duty (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act).

forms.name: Other Plaintiffs or Defendants (if needed)
forms.description: Only needed if there are additional plaintiffs or defendants beyond those listed on SC-100.

attachments_order.description: Copy of the demand letter sent to landlord
Proof that demand letter was sent (certified mail receipt)
Receipts or estimates contradicting landlord's charges

steps.instruction: Complete form SC-100 (Plaintiff's Claim). Fill in your name, address, the landlord/property management company name and address, the amount you're claiming, and a brief description of your claim.
steps.note: The claim amount should be the deposit amount you're demanding, up to $12,500 for individuals.

steps.instruction: Complete form SC-104 (Declaration of Nonmilitary Status).
Make 2 copies of all forms and supporting documents.
File at the clerk's office of the LA County Superior Court courthouse nearest to the rental property, or file online at the court's website.
steps.note: Filing can be done in person or by mail at most courthouses.

steps.instruction: Pay the filing fee (see fees below). Fee waiver available for qualifying individuals (form FW-001).
After filing, the court will schedule a hearing date and provide you with the Order to appear (on the SC-100 form).

Serve the defendant: you must have someone other than yourself (not a party to the case) serve a copy of the filed SC-100 on the landlord. Service must be completed at least 15 days before the hearing (20 days if outside the county).
steps.note: Service can be by personal service, substituted service, or certified mail with acknowledgment of receipt.

steps.instruction: File the Proof of Service (form SC-104A or POS-030) with the court before the hearing date.
Attend the hearing on the scheduled date. Bring all original documents, photos, and evidence organized in order.
steps.note: No attorneys are allowed in CA small claims court. The judge will hear both sides and make a decision, usually the same day or by mail.

service_of_process.method: Personal service by someone other than plaintiff; OR substituted service; OR certified mail with acknowledgment of receipt

filing_instructions.hearing_info: Hearing is typically scheduled 30-70 days after filing. Both parties present their case to the judge. No attorneys. Decision is usually made the same day or mailed within a few days.

statute_of_limitations.statute_ref: Cal. Civ. Proc. Code §337 (written contract) or §339 (oral contract, 2 years)
statute_of_limitations.description: For security deposit claims based on a written lease: 4 years. For oral agreements: 2 years. Clock starts when the deposit should have been returned (21 days after move-out).
